title: Minecraft BEST Hoglin Farm 1.21 - NEW - 176,000/HR!
description:
TheySix is here With a New Minecraft Tutorial, In This Minecraft Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Ultimate Hoglin Food & Leather Farm In Minecraft 1.21

🥰💗I Hope to Enjoy My Video Don't forget to like, comment subscribe it gives me more energy, and with this, you will support me

📚This farm is simple easy to build and can produce 17000 ~ 176000 Foods Per Hour!!! 
📚You need to build this farm in the crimson forest
📚Your farm rates depend on the number of layers that you built
📚The hoglin farm only works on the java edition also it will not work on paper mc servers there are conditions that you can turn off this limitation if you have access to server files ( bedrock breaking )
